a.h2: Peace of mind and reliability in every engine.
a.p: One turn of the key. Four cylinders breathe in a 1-3-4-2 sequence, the exhaust lets out its first breath and the whole system comes alive.

b.p: Full load. Two pistons up, two down: a perfectly balanced crankshaft to keep the pump going where other engines give up.

c.p: Live technical exploded view: every part labelled. Tap any part to see its spare parts.

d.p: End of cycle: parts return to place, the block cools down and is ready for the next shift. That's how every workday ends — and how yours begins.

benefits.intro: Every JF unit leaves the workshop tested under real load. This is what you get from the very first start.

rows.p: Mining-grade cast blocks, bench-verified torque and tolerances checked part by part before shipping.
Flat torque curve from 1,200 rpm: the pump holds steady flow even with dense slurry and suspended solids.
Parts for your engine and pump set with compatibility information. Get quotes and arrange everything on WhatsApp.
Calibrated to operate above 2,500 m: compensated injection, cold start and oversized cooling.
